title: LM Completion and Embedding
summary: This module provides core functionalities for interacting with Language Models (LMs) and embedding services. It includes synchronous and asynchronous methods for text completion, chat completion, and embedding generation, often leveraging caching and retry mechanisms.

nodes.label: Compute Embeddings (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous Embedding
nodes.description: Synchronously computes vector embeddings for input text, leveraging an internal caching mechanism to optimize performance and reducing redundant calls to the underlying embedding service.

nodes.label: Compute Embeddings (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous Embedding
nodes.description: Asynchronously computes vector embeddings for input text. This function leverages an internal caching mechanism to store and retrieve previous embeddings, enhancing performance and reducing latency for repeated requests.

nodes.label: Perform Chat Completion (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous Chat Completion
nodes.description: Manages synchronous chat completions through the LiteLLM API. It handles request preparation, applies caching strategies, implements retry logic for transient failures, and supports optional streaming of responses.

nodes.label: Perform Chat Completion (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous Chat Completion
nodes.description: Manages asynchronous chat completions through the LiteLLM API. This includes preparing requests, applying caching, implementing retry logic, and supporting asynchronous streaming of responses for improved responsiveness.

nodes.label: Perform Responses Completion (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous Responses
nodes.description: Facilitates synchronous calls to LiteLLM's `responses` endpoint. It converts standard chat requests into the appropriate format, applies caching, and incorporates retry strategies to ensure robust communication with the LM.

nodes.label: Perform Responses Completion (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous Responses
nodes.description: Facilitates asynchronous calls to LiteLLM's `aresponses` endpoint. This function converts chat requests, applies caching, and incorporates retry strategies, ensuring efficient and robust asynchronous communication with the LM.

nodes.label: Perform Text Completion (Sync)
nodes.title: Synchronous Text Completion
nodes.description: Executes synchronous text completions by transforming chat messages into a single prompt string. It then invokes LiteLLM's text completion API, managing API keys, base URLs, caching, and retry mechanisms for reliable operation.

nodes.label: Perform Text Completion (Async)
nodes.title: Asynchronous Text Completion
nodes.description: Executes asynchronous text completions by transforming chat messages into a single prompt string. It then invokes LiteLLM's text completion API, managing API keys, base URLs, caching, and retry mechanisms for reliable operation.

nodes.label: Wrap Async Stream
nodes.title: Async Stream Wrapper
nodes.description: A utility function designed to wrap and manage an asynchronous stream completion call. It enables the efficient handling and processing of streaming responses from language models, improving user experience.

nodes.label: LiteLLM API
nodes.title: LiteLLM Service
nodes.description: An external service that provides a unified interface for various Language Model APIs. It abstracts away provider-specific details, allowing for consistent interaction with different LMs.

nodes.label: Caching System
nodes.title: Response Caching
nodes.description: An internal or external caching mechanism used to store and retrieve previous LM and embedding responses. This system reduces redundant API calls, improves response times, and manages API rate limits.

nodes.label: Embedding Service
nodes.title: External Embedding Provider
nodes.description: An underlying external service responsible for generating vector embeddings from text inputs. This module acts as a cached proxy, providing an interface to this service while optimizing calls.

groups.label: Embedding Operations
groups.title: Embedding Operations
groups.description: Handles the generation of vector embeddings from text inputs, providing both synchronous and asynchronous interfaces with built-in caching.

groups.label: Synchronous LM Operations
groups.title: Synchronous LM Operations
groups.description: Provides synchronous interfaces for various Language Model completion tasks, including chat, responses, and raw text completion, with caching and retry logic.

groups.label: Asynchronous LM Operations
groups.title: Asynchronous LM Operations
groups.description: Provides asynchronous interfaces for various Language Model completion tasks, including chat, responses, and raw text completion, with caching, retry logic, and streaming support.
